preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some PocongNFT tokens to perform transfers

violation_target.exploit_hint: Call the vulnerable functions excludeFromFee() and includeInFee() as a non-owner to manipulate fee exemptions. First, call excludeFromFee() with your address to become exempt from all transaction fees (tax, liquidity, burn, dev). Then perform token transfers to avoid paying fees, effectively stealing value from the contract's fee mechanisms. Finally, you can call includeInFee() to remove the exemption if needed.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The functions excludeFromFee() and includeInFee() are supposed to be restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier, but the vulnerability description indicates that in the deployed contract, these functions lack proper access control. This allows any user to add or remove addresses from the fee exclusion list. By adding themselves to the exclusion list, an attacker can avoid all transaction fees (tax, liquidity, burn, dev) when transferring tokens, effectively stealing value from the fee mechanisms that would normally go to liquidity, burning, and development.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. First, obtain some PocongNFT tokens (as required by precondition). 2. Call excludeFromFee() with the attacker's address to become exempt from all fees. 3. Perform token transfers that would normally incur fees, demonstrating that no fees are deducted. 4. The economic benefit comes from avoiding the 10% total fee (1% tax + 3% liquidity + 1% burn + 5% dev), which preserves more token value for the attacker.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. In setUp(), use deal() to give the attacker some PocongNFT tokens. 2. In testExploit(), first record the attacker's initial token balance. 3. Call excludeFromFee(attacker) directly on the target contract. 4. Perform a token transfer to another address (could be a fresh address). 5. Compare balances to show that the transfer occurred without fee deductions. 6. Optionally call includeInFee(attacker) to demonstrate full control.
